noCard: You have no KPI card this quarter

board.below: {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} below target

quarters.sheetsConfirm: Approve the quarter sheets? Every employee will receive their PDF sheet by email.

card.note: Each item is scored as a percentage, and above 100% it is recorded as it is. An item that is «zero» or «at most» goes down proportionally if it goes over.
